gpu: RTX 3080 Ti (sm_86), single GPU, in-process scheduler+worker
validated_environment.notes: The adapter dual-form reads both the v0.34.0 release KVCacheGroupSpec and main's post-#61452 form (unit-validated); the second-engine validation runs are recorded in docs/TESTLOG.md.

status_legend.supported: implemented and validated end-to-end on the recorded environment
status_legend.passthrough: byte-copy without reinterpretation, gated by fingerprint equality
status_legend.rejected: registration fails closed with an explicit error
status_legend.partial: implemented with the stated limits; not all combinations validated
status_legend.unsupported: not implemented; lookups miss or registration fails by design

latent_kv.evidence: M4: tiny DeepSeek-V2 MLA with real vLLM kernels, token/hidden/logprob-exact vs native reuse

sliding_window_kv.evidence: M4: Gemma-2-2B-IT hybrid; 4,352-token shared prefix beyond the 4,096-token window restores the live trailing window
limits: restore trims to the trailing window interval

recurrent_state.evidence: M4 no-go spike: align-mode boundary CoW snapshots are not observable from the request-finished lifecycle (docs/M4.md)
recurrent_state.notes: fail-closed at registration, including recurrent groups inside hybrid engines

sparse_index.evidence: M4: explicit indexer-role metadata, opaque passthrough validated on CUDA fixtures

aux_state.notes: scratch/per-request rings excluded from transfer by design

known_limitations: Single GPU, single process; no TP/DCP/PCP sharding or replica writer election
Loads are synchronous (inside start_load_kv); async loads are future work
Codec overhead: NHD<->HND repack is a host-side torch permutation (~x38 vs memcpy at the M2 geometry)
heads-outermost layouts transfer as per-head fragment runs (correct, more ops)
no cross-engine reuse beyond the registered NHD<->HND codec; different fingerprints miss
